subject.title: [Bug] OPENCLAW_HOME 设置为 ~/.openclaw 时产生嵌套目录 ~/.openclaw/.openclaw

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87255 land with doctor-owned recovery as the upgrade path for existing nested `OPENCLAW_HOME` state?
rationale: The bug is real and the fix path is concrete, but changing canonical state/config roots can make existing nested config, credentials, or sessions appear missing unless maintainers accept the doctor recovery model.

options.title: Land with doctor recovery
options.body: Accept the canonical root switch and rely on `openclaw doctor --fix` to recover non-conflicting nested state while preserving conflicts for user choice.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a supported-runtime transcript that creates old nested state, runs doctor recovery, and confirms config plus credential/session recovery before merge.

options.title: Pause for runtime compatibility
options.body: Hold the fix if maintainers decide existing nested-root installs must continue to be read transparently at runtime.

recommendation.title: Land with doctor recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the canonical root switch and rely on `openclaw doctor --fix` to recover non-conflicting nested state while preserving conflicts for user choice.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path/config cleanup history makes this the best available owner for accepting or rejecting the compatibility tradeoff.
